steps.name: Beautiful Banquet (1)
steps.objective: First, talk to [Baldrick] in “Phobos” and defeat [Lilith] in “Cradle of Illusions” to obtain <Tears of Deep Darkness>. Then report the quest to [Veled] in “Phobos.”

lines.text: (At the entrance to the Cradle of Hwans on one side of Phobos, Baldrick is sitting with his eyes closed and seems to be thinking about something.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baldrick, how are you?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Brother?
(Baldrick stands up with a happy expression.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Brother, nice to meet you! Are you here to see me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Baldrick. Everyone told me to come, but I guess it wasn't Baldrick.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: That's right, but you're saying you're not busy right now? Do you want to spar with me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then can I learn something? Please keep it short instead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baldrick?
(Baldrick taps %s on the shoulder with an overwhelmed expression.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: After all, my brother is the only one. Let's see. How about just 30 minutes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Let's do our best to not kill each other.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Enough so that we don't kill each other? Ugh… .
(Suddenly, Baldric's fist flies next to %s's head. Although he hastily dodges it, the rock inside is shattered.)
(Baldrick's attacks continue, and the two of them spar with each other by parrying or dodging.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh, it'll be hard to avoid this time.)
(Baldrick's happy voice is heard in the ears of %s, who was waiting for the attack with his eyes closed.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: It's over now!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahaha, it was fun. Now wake up.
(Baldrick grabs %s's hand and lifts him up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, it was truly the longest 30 minutes in the world.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Now, let’s drink some water and take a break.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Baldrick. But what were you thinking earlier?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I had a strange dream so I woke up. I think the teacher came out and said something, but I don't remember.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: … It seems like he was looking for something... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: %s, let’s go to Master’s village with me for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay to go, but can I just take a break? uh? Uh huh?
(Baldrick picks up %s against his will and places him on his shoulder. He then runs to the cradle of the illusion with an apologetic expression on his face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: What is this… ?
(Baldrick holds up a small gem found on one side of the cradle of illusions.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This feels similar to purgatory. Strange beings in purgatory were carrying it... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Ah, this is it. But why is it here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not at all, I don't know.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: … Sniff.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I can feel the smell of the demon world... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you smell that?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: That's how it happened in life. Should I take it to Brother Beled? I think I know something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will Beled be there?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: We found a tent that was blown away by the wind. I barely escaped falling into a well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like the tent is still not secured well.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: He thanked me and told me to come see him at any time if I need help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's go to Beled.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Let's go, brother.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just a moment. I'm going to walk, so don't carry me on your shoulder!

steps.name: Beautiful Banquet (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Asmodea] in “Rosengarten” to obtain “Teacher’s Glasses.” Then report the quest to [Veled] in “Phobos.”

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Phew. Beautiful castle, please don't fly away. If you fall into a well, you won't know where to go.
(Baldrick and %s appear in Beled's field of vision as he pulls the tent's straps to secure it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beled, how are you?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: %s, it’s been a while. I already had a conversation with Baldrick a few hours ago. I defeated Weiss... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: And what purpose the magic stone used by Weiss was used for and how it was made... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: With that magic stone... .
(Beled cannot continue speaking for a moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beled, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'm fine. It's because I'm in a bit of a bad mood when I talk about Vice. Hehe, look carefully. You become beautiful quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because it’s beauty… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Thanks to %s, I feel like I have less worries about Peonia. Mars will get better now, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's how it should be. They said they would consult closely with the representatives of each village.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: It would be nice if we didn't fight like we used to. Peonia is going to be busy too.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: The air in Phobos seems to be clearer than before. Could it be that bad energy has disappeared from the continent?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I feel the air has become clearer. Since all the bad energy disappears, I don’t feel like I’ve been to the demon world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Demon world?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yes, demon world. Somehow I ended up going there. But I don't know how to get there again.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Come to think of it, my brother, you were the devil, right?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Baldrick, I am the devil. No, it's not a devil, but it seems like a devil, and isn't it still too beautiful to pretend to be a devil?
(Beled points to herself, saying she is beautiful, but no one pays attention.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: He just came by for a short time and didn't pay much attention to me. ‘Rosengarten’ is not the only realm of dream demons… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I went to check on something, but there was no harvest. I'll go again later when I have a chance. But what are you holding?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I felt the energy of the demon world in the object I was holding, so I tried to wait for him to tell me, but I couldn't. Hurry up and give it to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I forgot because I was talking about it. Well, here it is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It is said that after meeting Baldrick and hearing the dream story, he went to the Cradle of Hwans and found a teardrop-shaped gem inside that contained the power of darkness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's similar to what the otherworldly beings had in Avalon.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's a dream... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: You don’t know either?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's something filled with deep darkness... . I'll have to take a look and see what's in it. But why was this found there? Rosengarten is clearly gone... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Has the door to the demon world been opened? If it was open, there's no way Baldrick and I wouldn't know... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: %s… . I need some more time to check. So, would you like to go there sometime?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: That well you see over there. I feel something over there... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Should I go too? Because the dream spot is suspicious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back.
(As the two people go down to the well where they entered Rosengarten, Beled quietly looks at the object in his hand.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It feels like this item was left behind on purpose and disappeared... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glasses? It looks unique.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Brother, give it to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, here… .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Why is this here? It’s the teacher’s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Master, are these glasses correct?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: That's right. Even though time has passed and even if I'm not smart, my memory is good. This is definitely a teacher's.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hmm… . These are women's glasses... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baldrick's teacher passed away hundreds of years ago.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: … okay. A long time ago… .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Glasses discovered in a place where there were traces of the Demon World... . Was this why the dream was so wild?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Brother, let’s go to Brother Beled first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Baldric.
(Beled looks closely at the glasses that Baldrick gave him.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: This is... . I'm not sure... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Did you find out anything?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Have you ever met other demons or demons other than beautiful beings like me?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I've met guys who came to take me down. Brother, but why is that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beled, by any chance, are those glasses imbued with the power of the demon world?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I can't say it's not me. It's clear that these aren't ordinary glasses. And I have something to tell you. There is something you brought me earlier.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, why is that?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Look carefully. That jewel and these glasses... .
(Beled places the glasses and the tears of deep darkness together on the box he is using instead of a table. Then, the two objects shake as if in resonance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Reacting like this means that the users of these items are the same or connected.
(After a while, the gem called Tears of Deep Darkness splits and shatters.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: … It seems like the glasses are stronger.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: That's right. This jewel contains the power of another world, and these glasses are definitely from the demon world... .
(As Baldrick takes the glasses from the box, Beled looks at him with a puzzled expression.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: So you're saying there's nothing more you can know?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Everything I know comes from Asmodea's memories and experiences.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hmm, okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baldrick?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I was wondering for a moment what I should do now that Vice disappeared, but it worked out well. If you look for demons with these glasses, you will also learn about your teacher.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I got curious. I thought maybe I didn't know too much about my teacher.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't think it's that simple of a question, does it?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Let’s think simply, brother. Because complicated things are annoying.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Baldrick will do well. Are you sure you can destroy the Demon Realm?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm really scared that you would do that?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: If the Demon World is destroyed, wouldn't it be a good thing for the human world? It seems like beings from the demon world are still targeting this place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … That's it, but I still think something will happen. So how do you get to the demon world?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: While traveling to and from other continents, I heard that there is a door to the demon world, but I don't know where it is.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: So I will find it. Because there is a lot of time anyway. Hahaha, thank you. %s Brother, Brother Beled.
(As soon as he finishes speaking, Baldrick hurries away and runs somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baldrick? Baldrick? Where are you going all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Is that kind of side to you when you become human?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beled, have you found a way to become human?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Not yet… . I'm still looking. I have something to look up related to the soul.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'll tell you later when I find out something. uh?
(Beled's expression changes dramatically when he sees a group of people approaching him.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's Peonia! Peonia, come quickly!

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Beled, don’t be too clingy. Ah, %s… . long time no see.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Haam… , Adventurer was there too?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Ahaha, brothers. I'm back too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nice to meet you all. I saw Baldrick earlier, so it's okay. But what's going on everyone?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I'm going to have a meal with Beled. No, to talk.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: I was surprised when suddenly Uncle Baldrick snatched the meat container.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, you suddenly disappeared.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Peonia, what are you talking about? What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I bring good news to everyone. that is… .

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: I decided to prepare a residence for Beled and Uncle Baldrick in Mars. P.O put in a lot of effort.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Really? really? Peonia, thank you! I love it so much!

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Beled, go!! All of a sudden, don’t come closer!!
(Pionia pushes Beled away slightly, looking embarrassed at his face.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Haha, brother, it's good! Good! So let’s grill and eat all this meat!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know why it ended up being meat, but it worked out well anyway!

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: … This was all possible because the Deimos Church disappeared. %s and thank you, Uncle Baldrick. And Beled also had a hard time… .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I will work hard too. In the future, I will work harder than now to revive Mars. Everyone, please take care of yourselves in the future.
(When Peonia smiles hopefully, everyone responds with a warm smile. Only one person, Baldrick, laughs loudly instead of smiling.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahahaha, then let’s all eat meat together!
(Everyone bursts out laughing at Baldrick's words, and Fionia and Chrysien take out the food they had prepared.)
(Later, Baldrick spoke of the meal he had in front of Beled's beautiful castle as follows: It was a beautiful banquet for people dreaming of a bright future.)
